The agent never stepped back to fix the underlying file-generation/tooling approach that kept re-introducing the bug — the churn the level-10 anchor explicitly penalizes.

reasoning: The agent reliably treats failing tests and server-log tracebacks as signal, drilling to the real cause and fixing the affected logic (serialization, regex, exception handling, imports) rather than special-casing tests — solidly matching the level-5 anchor. It reaches slightly toward level 8 by seriously considering a foundational engine swap (the `formulas` library), but abandons that rework and never re-architects any inadequate component. Countervailing evidence keeps it from rising: it repeatedly re-introduces and re-diagnoses the same escaping bug without addressing the root tooling cause, which is the thrashing churn the top anchors warn against. Net: a clear, sustained level 5.
